page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Defaults applied every time the dashboard loads and to the import tools.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save the settings. Please try again.

gapThreshold.label: Dashed-line threshold (days)
gapThreshold.help: A gap of more than X days between two points is drawn as a dashed line.

transactionsSection.label: Transactions
transactionsSection.defaultAccountLabel: Default account on the Transactions page

duplicateThreshold.label: Default similarity threshold (possible duplicates)
duplicateThreshold.help: Filters out duplicate groups whose label similarity is below the threshold.

mcp.description: Lets a local assistant (Ollama via an MCP client) manage your transactions. Content is encrypted with the token — nothing travels in the clear.
mcp.tokenWarning: This token will not be shown again — copy it now.
mcp.tokenConfigHint: Configure the MCP client with <1>ATHENA_MCP_USER</1> (your username) and<3> ATHENA_MCP_TOKEN</3>.

bankSync.description: Connect your banks through Enable Banking (PSD2) to import transactions automatically. Optional — OFX/CSV file import remains the baseline.
bankSync.guide: Create a free account at enablebanking.com, link your own bank accounts (restricted production mode), create an application with the redirect URL below, then paste its application ID and private key here. The key is encrypted and never leaves your server.
bankSync.redirectUrlLabel: Redirect URL to declare in your Enable Banking application:
bankSync.saveSuccess: Credentials validated with Enable Banking and saved.
bankSync.deleteDialogDescription: Existing bank connections will stop syncing until new credentials are saved.

errors.invalidKey: Invalid private key — paste the full PEM file.
errors.rejected: Enable Banking rejected these credentials. Check the application ID and key.

connect.label: Connect a bank
connect.hint: You will be redirected to your bank to authorize read-only access (one mobile confirmation). Access stays valid for 90–180 days.

manual.help: If the return page is unreachable (redirect URL differs from Athena's address), copy the full URL shown in the address bar after authorizing — the code is in it — and paste it here.
manual.success: Connection created. Map the accounts in the card below.
manual.error: The exchange failed — the code is single-use and short-lived. Start the connection again.
manual.noCode: No code found in the pasted text.

connections.label: Connections
connections.disconnectDialogDescription: Mapped accounts will stop syncing. Already-imported transactions are kept.

callback.title: Bank connection
callback.exchanging: Finalizing the connection with your bank…
callback.mappingHelp: Map each bank account to an Athena account. Accounts marked “Skip” won't sync — you can change this later in Settings.
callback.error: The connection failed. Start the connection again from Settings.
callback.noCode: No authorization code in the URL — start the connection again from Settings.

reset.dialogDescription: All your settings will return to their default values. This action cannot be undone.

help.description: Shows the guided tour and every hidden section tip again.

security.postgresPointer: Encryption at rest protects the local database file (PGlite). This installation uses PostgreSQL, so protecting the data volume is up to your server infrastructure — see the documentation (https://gekkotron.github.io/Athena-Accounting/docs/users/encryption-at-rest) for the recommended setup (disk encryption, encrypted backups).
security.noRecoveryWarning: Warning: if you forget this password, your data will be permanently unrecoverable — unless you have a backup exported beforehand. There is no way to reset this password.
security.disablePending: Disabling encryption is scheduled: it will take effect the next time the application starts.
security.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

enable.title: Enable encryption
enable.success: Encryption enabled. Restart the application to finish the migration and remove the unencrypted copy.

disable.title: Disable encryption
disable.note: Disabling only takes effect the next time the application starts.

onboarding.title: First use
onboarding.subtitle: Create your username and password to get started.

form.subtitleRegister: Choose a username and a password. Your data will be kept fully separate from other users.

form.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
form.localFirstText: Your data never leaves your network.

page.title: Profile
page.subtitle: Change your username or password. Your current password is asked every time to confirm it's really you.

form.newPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current password

errors.currentPasswordRequired: The current password is required to confirm.
errors.newPasswordTooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
